test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the center (but not necessarily in the same order). C is sitting to the immediate right of B. E is sitting third to the left of B. D is the immediate neighbour of E and F. A is sitting to the immediate right of C.

What is the position of G with respect to B?
solution:
Given:

Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the center.

C is sitting to the immediate right of B.

A is sitting to the immediate right of C.

E is sitting third to the left of B.

D is the immediate neighbour of E and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e27b2e7fea724afcee254e83d983c530a7de8dc1360219d38905fa702dcba27f.png] 

Thus, 'G' is third to the right of 'B'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
